brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has discussed with US President Donald Trump the possibility of resuming military action against Iran, according to Middle East Eye citing Israel's Channel 12. The discussions reportedly centered on timing the resumption of conflict before the US elections.

The report did not specify what form such military action would take or provide further details on Trump's response to Netanyahu's push.
